currentAuthoritativeSource.heading: ## Resolve a cast at the table

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Ready

Spend an Action to declare a perceivable trigger and one legal Action-time action or movement. It expires next regular own-turn start. **NEW:** only one pending Ready per creature; replacing it loses the prior setup and any paid held-spell costs. No Bonus Action/Reaction ability, long ritual or multi-minute activity can be prepared by generic Ready.

The trigger happens first, then the readied response immediately follows before later events, unless a specific effect explicitly interrupts. On release spend the normal Reaction and recheck target, range, sight/perception, line of effect, ammunition and other prerequisites. An invalid or declined occurrence spends no release resource; the Ready can wait for another valid occurrence before expiry. This does not undo setup costs. Once released, it is consumed.

For ordinary nonspell actions, feature/ammunition costs are paid on release unless text charges setup. A readied **Attack Action** gets its legally available ordinary attack count; a feature limited to your own turn does not thereby work off-turn. Core Overwatch is explicitly one ranged attack, not that full Attack Action and not Soldier's distinct engine.

A readied spell is actually **cast at preparation**: choose spell/mode, verify legality, pay RP/material/other costs, provide components, resolve Dissonance/Refrain and cast-trigger effects once. Counterspell/cast-interruption opportunity occurs then, not again at release. Every held spell requires concentration, even ordinarily non-concentration spells; incompatible prior concentration ends. Lost concentration loses the held spell and costs. NEW: select the legal target/area point at release and recheck legality without repaying. At release the hold continues as ordinary spell concentration if required, otherwise ends after resolution. Expired/replaced/countered held spells do not refund paid costs.

Ready movement grants a separate current-Speed budget on release, pays terrain costs and can provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. It grants no extra Action, Bonus Action or interaction.

Focused stance's Reaction restriction also blocks an ordinary Ready release; Ready does not create a Counterspell exception. Holding a spell does not waive any current Reaction prohibition.

**Spell-effect duration begins at release.** Its normal duration is anchored when the effect manifests, while Ready expiry and held concentration already run from preparation. A source explicitly tying a particular consequence to casting/preparation retains that consequence's stated clock. No casting cost, Refrain, Dissonance or cast trigger occurs a second time merely from release.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.

## Time and event ordering — NEW

For a duration created in initiative, record the relevant original regular start/end marker. Existing effects keep that **virtual marker**, repeating every six seconds if the creature leaves or changes initiative. Reordering, rerolling, extra turns, death/removal or leaving/reentering initiative never restart an existing duration. New effects use the current schedule. Source death still ends concentration, a source-dependent aura/tether or an effect explicitly ending on death.

- A bare hostile target-bound **N rounds** ends at the Nth future regular target-end marker. An in-progress target turn's current end does not count.
- A bare self/source buff, ally-targeted buff or source-controlled aura **N rounds** ends at the Nth future source-start marker. Explicit target-turn, pulse or absolute timing overrides this default. Activation during source turn 1 for three rounds ends at source turn 4's start.
- **Next turn** means the next future regular turn of the named creature, not the current turn's still-upcoming end. An unqualified next turn refers to source/user under the existing shared rule. Explicit “this turn” can include the current turn.
- An outside-initiative bare N-round effect instead gets an absolute application-time + N×6 seconds deadline. Entering initiative preserves that deadline.
- Explicit periodic profiles retain their registered clocks and tick counts. Never create a second timer merely because a generic duration rule also exists.

The [exact GPT review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_COMBAT_EXACT_FINDINGS.md) confirms ally-buff source clocks and excluding the current turn for explicit next-turn endpoints. The helper excludes a specific current-end marker only if that marker would otherwise be selected: application during a turn at time1 with end3 excludes3 and selects9; application at/after3 also selects9, without erroneously skipping again to15.

At a regular turn's **start**, resolve in this order:

1. Expire start-ending effects and apply immediate state changes from those expirations.
2. Refresh Reaction; tick regular-start recharge/non-action clocks.
3. Resolve already-due absolute state recovery if now legal, including a previously blocked Stable recovery deadline.
4. If still alive, dying and at 0 HP with death saves, make that turn's death save.
5. Resolve other start effects and periodic events in application order.
6. Begin voluntary turn decisions.

At **end**, resolve triggered effects, due damage, saves and maintenance before end-ending effects expire; then the slot finishes. No extra turn creates another regular marker. The caller must not reuse a resolved marker.

For simultaneous effects, earlier application timestamp precedes later. For simultaneous components of one source, its printed internal order controls; otherwise use stable application sequence, with source/mechanical ID as a final tie-break. Record that sequence when creating the effects. Beneficial/harmful labels do not change priority. Periodic family arbitration happens once per family/marker before its damage, retaining the family registry's consumed loser ticks.

Examples: dying at 0 rolls its death save before ordinary start-turn healing; a fatal death save is not undone by ordinary healing. Stable at 0 skips the save, then start-turn damage can break Stable. A natural 20 can restore 1 HP before a due Bleed drops it to 0 as a new drop event. If Decay expires while a Stable recovery deadline is already due, the old deadline resolves once without rerolling recovery time.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Movement and geometry

Track **spent movement cost**, not distance, for ordinary turn movement. Mode cap = `(1 + number of legal Dash actions this turn) × current Speed for that mode`; remaining = max(0, cap − spent cost). Switching modes never refunds cost. Recalculate cap on Speed changes, preserving spent cost. Stand from Prone costs floor(half current Speed) and requires nonzero Speed and enough budget. Dropping Prone costs no movement.

For each foot traveled, normal/difficult/severe terrain costs 1/2/3; use strongest terrain only. Add +1 for crawling and +1 for squeezing. Crawl in difficult =3:1; crawl+squeeze in difficult =4:1. A nonhostile occupied space counts as difficult terrain. Enter a hostile creature's space only with ≥two-size difference or an express feature; never willingly end in an occupied space. Squeeze through a space one size smaller, with own attack/DEX-save disadvantage and attacks-against advantage.

Walk10 through difficult spends20; switch to Fly30 leaves10. Stand with Speed30 spends15; switching to Fly30 leaves15. Two legal Dashes at Speed30 give cap90; prior expenditure still counts. Interpose/Press grant5 budget: they cannot enter a difficult 5-ft tile costing10. Their separate budgets never refill ordinary movement. Ready movement uses Speed at release; Withdraw uses half current Speed. All voluntary movement requires nonzero relevant Speed.

Forced movement does not use these ledgers or provoke ordinary opportunity attacks, cannot place creatures in solid matter, and stops at obstacles. Teleport does not traverse intervening terrain or spend Speed unless printed; it requires a legal destination. Speed0 alone does not block forced movement or teleport. Flight with Prone/Speed0/lost support causes Falling unless Hover or an explicit magical support exception applies; use the existing fixed Fall Marker procedure. Reaching support ends Falling.

NEW grid metric: each orthogonal or diagonal neighboring tile is 5 ft; use the same metric for ordinary ranges/areas. No diagonal cut through a corner when both adjacent orthogonal sides are completely blocked. Exact templates, 3D geometry, mounts, chases, jumping, climbing/swimming procedures and currents need further source review.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Resolve a damage event

Resolve each genuinely separate hit or damage event once. Do not split one packet to multiply Wound saves or combine separate hits merely to cross a threshold. Feature-specific prevention that acts before damage or before reaching zero resolves at its printed timing first.

1. Resolve attack/save, damage and applicable defenses. The remaining nonnegative amount is **resolved damage**.
2. Record HP, Wounds and zero-HP state before the event. Remove temporary HP first. **Post-temp damage = resolved damage minus temporary HP absorbed.** Keep this amount even when it exceeds current HP; floor the resulting current HP at zero.
3. Check V6 Instant Death. If post-temp damage minus HP before the hit is at least maximum HP, the creature dies. For a creature already at zero, this is post-temp damage at least maximum HP. Stop: there is no Wound save, death-save failure or successful knockout from that event.
4. Otherwise, a living creature makes one Wound save if it dropped from positive HP to zero, if **2 × post-temp damage is at least maximum HP**, or if the effect actually inflicts Maiming. Overlapping triggers still cause only one save. The post-temp threshold and one-save rule are new provisional interpretations. Maiming is an independent trigger even when temporary HP absorbs all ordinary damage; immunity to Maiming itself still applies.
5. Make a Constitution save against **max(10, floor(post-temp damage / 2))**. Use pre-event Wounds for the -1-per-Wound penalty. Maiming with zero post-temp damage uses DC 10. A Wound gained now cannot penalize the roll that created it.
6. A success adds no Wound. A failure that began with zero, one or two Wounds adds exactly one; failure by 5 or more also gives that Wound one Injury. A failure that began with three Wounds kills the creature instead: no fourth Wound and no Injury roll. Stop processing later living-target consequences if dead.
7. If the creature was already at zero before this event and post-temp damage is positive, end Stable. A creature using death saves adds one failure, or two for a critical hit; three failures kill it. An ordinary creature that does not use death saves dies instead, without starting death counters. A hit from positive HP to zero does not also cause a same-packet death failure.
8. If this event newly reduces positive HP to zero, a valid melee knockout makes the surviving creature Stable. Otherwise a character/significant NPC using death saves begins dying; an ordinary monster dies. A previously Stable creature whose temporary HP absorbed all damage remains Stable unless an independent Maiming result killed it. The Director identifies significant NPCs consistently. Knockout cannot override Instant Death or a fatal Wound save.

Core's Maiming and Wound trigger rules remain subject to an actual feature's eligibility. The reference helper receives already legal events; it does not grant every attack Maiming or a damage-prevention exception.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Zero HP and recovery

A living character at zero HP is Unconscious. Core's condition already includes Incapacitated, unawareness, dropping held items and falling Prone; an adjacent hit is critical as specified there. Healing does not silently remove other independent causes of Unconscious or Prone.

While dying, make one death save at the **start of each regular initiative turn**. Roll d20 without modifiers unless a feature specifically modifies death saves. Natural 20 restores 1 HP; natural 1 adds two failures. Other results of 10 or more add one success; 9 or less add one failure. Three successes make the creature Stable; three failures make it Dead. Extra turns and Actions add no extra death saves. Stable or Dead creatures do not roll them.

Regaining positive HP or becoming Stable resets both counters. Temporary HP does not raise normal HP, end Unconscious or reset counters. Fully absorbed damage does not end Stable or add a death failure in this provisional interpretation. Independent Maiming can still cause its Wound save.

**Stabilize:** an Action and DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or an Action using one healer's-kit use automatically, stabilizes a living dying creature at zero. It remains Unconscious and makes no death saves. Roll 1d4 once when it becomes Stable and record its absolute recovery time that many hours later. If still Stable then, it regains 1 HP. Damage reaching normal HP cancels that deadline and resumes dying with the appropriate failures. Rest and Stable recovery use the same elapsed clock, so four hours of recovery inside an eight-hour Watch do not cost twelve hours. A later rest does not separately replay the Stable healing event.

**Dead:** ordinary healing and stabilization do not restore life. Resurrection must satisfy its own willing-soul, body, time, cost and target rules. It does not automatically remove Wounds, Corruption, debts, legal death or claims upon the body. Corpses cannot supply repeated resource triggers.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.

## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid 3-pulse effect, start is pulse 1; pay maintenance on each of the next 2 regular turns by turn end for pulses 2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn 4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.

Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless explicitly stated, cannot place a creature inside solid matter, and stops at an obstacle. Grapples use the card's save/DC, can be escaped with an Action and STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against that DC, and end beyond reach. A root sets Speed 0 but does not remove Actions. Slows reduce Speed to minimum 0. Silence blocks verbal spells/audible abilities, not all thought or all class features. Charmed effects never determine a player's beliefs; use only the printed action restrictions.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.

### Null Veil

**Duration.** Persists until one listed purge succeeds. Exiting field alone does not end it.

**Passive Insight.** While Veil is active and not suppressed, final passive Insight is 5. This is a setting of that passive score, not omniscience or motive detection. Suppression restores normal calculation for its duration.

**Creation-time nonlethal damage flag.** At creation of each damage root, record root dealer. If that dealer is a character currently under unsuppressed Null Veil, mark the entire root `nullNonlethal=true`. Descendant delayed/ongoing packets inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A distinct later activation/attack creates a new root and re-evaluates. A companion/minion has its own dealer identity. Controller Veil does not convert companion damage unless an exact ability says the controller is the damage dealer. Pure transfer/redirection keeps the original root's nullNonlethal flag. It does not create a second root or extra prevention/resource triggers. An effect that explicitly creates new reflected/retaliatory damage uses the reflector as dealer and evaluates that new root at creation. A mere transfer is not reflection.

When a root is qualifying Null-nonlethal, use this order:

1. Snapshot recipient identity/lifecycle, pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds/death state and the root nullNonlethal flag. Resolve ordinary defenses, resistance and temp-HP absorption and calculate the ordinary post-temp damage/HP loss values; attached non-damage riders remain pending under their own triggers.
2. If nullNonlethal is false, use the ordinary CORE/HEALING_DEATH/lifecycle procedure unchanged. If true, continue below. Objects/noncreature structures still take ordinary object damage and can be destroyed; the word nonlethal does not make objects indestructible.
3. For any living-recipient qualifying damage packet, suppress damage-caused Instant Death and suppress the packet’s Core Wound/Maiming save entirely, including half-maximum and positive-HP Wound triggers. Therefore the packet cannot create a fatal fourth-Wound result while the recipient remains above 0 or reaches 0. Existing Wounds remain recorded.
4. Apply normal HP loss down to minimum 0. Positive→positive: stop the Null zero-state branch; recipient keeps resulting positive HP, existing Wounds/conditions and independent riders. Positive→0 ordinary living: skip damage-caused death/death-save failures and establish Stable0 with counters reset and exactly one ordinary Stable recovery deadline, unless a source-specific zero-HP permission such as actual Undying Spellform applies as stated below.
5. Already Dying0: qualifying damage causes no new damage failure/death and does not stabilize, clear counters or move the existing death-save schedule. Already Stable0: causes no failure/death and keeps the existing recovery deadline exactly; never reroll/extend it. If temp HP absorbs the entire normal-HP loss so HP never reaches0, no zero-state transition occurs.
6. For nonliving/companion/projection recipients, use exactly one explicit recipientLifecycle branch below; do not infer anatomy from a name. The Null override replaces only the damage-caused lethal/destruction endpoint named by that branch. Independent duration, dismissal, concentration/source end, sacrifice/cost, Hunt finality or other non-damage expiry remains real.
7. Would-die/death-trigger protections do not trigger or spend if their prerequisite death/fatal branch was skipped by Null. A source-specific trigger keyed only to damage reducing HP to0 without killing, such as actual Undying Spellform, still triggers. Independent non-damage riders resolve if their own trigger remains true and they do not require a Wound/death result.
8. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are never converted. New reflected/retaliatory damage that is a new root re-evaluates its own dealer; pure transfer/redirection preserves the original root flag and does not duplicate root triggers.

### Recipient lifecycles for qualifying Null damage

**Ordinary living recipient.** Use orderedAlgorithm steps 3–5. Positive→positive: no packet-created Wound/Instant Death. New positive→0: Stable0 unless an exact source-specific zero permission overrides. Already Dying0: same counters/markers. Already Stable0: same recovery deadline.

**Ranger Beast.** Source normally dies immediately at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces that damage-caused immediate-death transition with Null Disabled at0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no commands/actions; same animal/bond remains. Ordinary legal companion healing above0 ends Disabled. A later independent non-damage death/removal rule still works.

**Finite summon, Familiar or Mirror Beast.** Source normally disappears/ends at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces only that damage-caused zero disappearance with Null Disabled at0 while its original duration/source still exists. Independent duration expiry, dismissal, concentration/source end or replacement still ends it. Legal companion healing above0 restores function; no generic repair/resummon is granted.

**Mage Lich elite.** Source normally becomes destroyed bound asset at0. Qualifying Null damage leaves same elite Null Disabled at0, not destroyed; therefore Soulbound is not legal solely from this zero. Legal companion healing above0 restores it. An independent actual destruction/expiry can later create its normal destroyed state.

**Wizard standard undead.** Qualifying Null damage leaves same minion Null Disabled at0 instead of damage-caused destruction. Dismissal or owner completed-LR expiry still ends it. Legal healing above0 if a real source applies may restore it.

**Authored local projection.** A scene projection whose authored 0-HP rule says disperse/end uses that administrative projection endpoint even under Null; it is not a living death/Wound branch. ACT-FEAST-STEWARD instead uses its explicit Collapsed Projection rule. This classification must be printed in the actor profile, not inferred from a name.

**Undying Spellform.** If qualifying damage newly reduces a Mage with actual Undying Spellform to0 without killing outright, its printed trigger occurs and its 1/LR use is spent. It overrides zero-HP Unconscious/Incapacitated permissions as reviewed: conscious, half-Speed voluntary movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting/concentration, no independent BA/Reaction. Triggering damage still causes its concentration save. If still0 at feature expiry, the reviewed expiry destabilizes/cancels Stable recovery and adds one failed death save; that later feature-expiry event is not the original Null damage packet.

**Would-die protections.** A protection whose trigger requires actual death/would-die/fatal result does not trigger and spends no use when Null skips that damage-caused death branch. Do not replay it later. Separate minimum-HP prevention that resolves earlier follows its own source if actually triggered.

**Actual nonliving Construct.** For an actual nonliving Construct creature with an authored HP/destruction endpoint, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces only damage-caused destruction with Null Disabled0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands. Same construct identity remains; no corpse/parts/loot are generated by the zero. Only an actual repair/heal rule that expressly applies to that construct can raise it above0 and end Disabled; no generic repair is granted.

**Silence Wraith only.** For ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH specifically, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces its damage-caused dispersal with Null Disabled0 (Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions). It has no corpse/soul/loot. The chamber’s independent correct-plate terminal may still pacify/disperse that same identity; no generic healing/repair is invented.

**Local actor bindings.** ACT-TOY-SENTINEL: ordinaryNonlivingConstruct; ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH: localSpirit; ACT-ACCORD-DEVIL: localProjection; ACT-ACCORD-DEMON: localProjection; ACT-ECHO-DOPPELGANGER: localProjection; ACT-FEAST-STEWARD: explicit Collapsed Projection actor rule; ACT-NULL-WITNESS: ordinaryLiving; ACT-GLASS-MENDER-SENTINEL: localProjection.

**What Null Veil does not erase.** Does not remove old Wounds/Injuries, revive Dead creatures, clear existing dying counters, rewrite death history, cure conditions, or prevent non-damage lethal costs/tracks. Newly-zero stabilization resets only its current death-save counters because becoming Stable requires that under Core. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are not converted. This nonlethal override does not alter Hunt finality or Hunted Death rules for actual later deaths from other causes.

## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger.

The [rank-2 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK2_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves this specific companion overlay: **when an exact companion source prints multiple attacks as one damaging action, those attacks are components of one commanded offensive action and consume the owner's single offensive-companion allowance unless that source expressly grants otherwise.** Summon Air Pet explicitly makes its two source attacks within that one action; no second command/action or remaining offense for another companion is created. Its fixed AC15/HP20/two 1d6 attacks do not inherit generic companion scaling.

Planar Ally (Minor) uses a finite NEW summon-only profile for the source's intended CR-1 role. The bounded public bestiary scan did not establish an eligible published exact-CR1 extraplanar creature; this card does not certify its CR or rewrite a bestiary entry. Summon Weaponry Satchel has finite conjured contents tied to one duration, with a narrow exception only for an already resolving immediate use. Alignment Weapon's suppression default applies only to that printed card.

Resonance Well rolls one 1d4 total reserve. Its separately named creation and receipt uses commit before prevention and reset only through each character's beneficial long rest. These limits neither share nor reset Kindle or Mod Rod records. Read the exact cards and [rank-2 status](CONJURATION_RANK2_REVIEW_STATUS.json); pricing/schema checks do not execute these effects or certify balance.

The [rank-3 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) adds seven bounded cards. Earth Pet's knockdown is Prone, not positional movement; generic push/pull immunity does not automatically prevent it. Burst of Flamewind affects every creature the caster ordinarily classifies as an enemy at a known location in its cone, with automatic source damage and a save controlling only its push.

Elemental Displacement selects a nearby willing recipient and a perceived destination; its teleport path is not constrained by intervening terrain. Spectral Steed actually crosses planes to a known site, once per steed attempt. Its 350-pound **and** 12-Load limits count the rider's body and all gear, including melded equipment. The reviewed correction from the conference's proposed6Load avoids excluding all gear from a Medium rider; ordinary Burdened applies at6Load. Read the exact mount/command/arrival procedure; it does not close general mounted combat.

Resonance Conduit transfers already-existing RP between two separate pools, with committed deductions, gated credit, and no resource creation or daily-ledger reset. Renewed consent cannot revive an ended application, but a new legal paid cast may create a new one. Faction Portal provides actual one-way travel to a known HQ on the same or another plane. Its positive-standing predicate uses the current canonical reputation record without migrating its scale. Travel may bypass a geographic route; elapsed clocks, cargo custody, contamination, claims, arrival law and settlement remain actual procedures. These cards do not declare automatic Extraction success or invent a blanket prohibition on planar escape. [Review status](CONJURATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves the manuscript/runtime/balance distinction.

 Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

## Placement and involuntary endings

A transformation does not grant movement. A voluntary size change keeps the same spatial anchor and must fit before payment. Preserve the existing footprint on a same-size change when possible.

A mandatory ending still occurs if the root anatomy does not fit. First try its normal space at the same position, then a legal squeeze under the [movement rules](COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md). If neither fits, record a placement conflict. The **new provisional placement procedure** permits only a nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space. Choose the minimum displacement that fits the whole body; among ties, preserve the greatest overlap with its previous footprint. If still tied, the Director uses a fixed neutral board order, not a tactical choice by the affected player. If no adjacent candidate fits, the conflict remains until the obstruction is removed or a legal relocation effect resolves it. Do not search farther afield.

This mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no opportunity attack, charge distance, movement benefit or other movement rider. It changes no remaining movement allowance and grants no invented crushing damage. It does not permit a voluntary form change to bypass its preflight.

Track actual height and terrain. Losing flight while unsupported starts ordinary falling from the current location; reversion never moves the creature directly to the ground. Ending a burrowing form underground does not move the creature to the surface. Master of Vermin's permission to pass through Tiny gaps changes clearance, not its printed size.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Carrying and Load

Use pounds for actual weight and Load for inventory burden. Extraction Class describes cargo danger and attention. A casualty's Load describes the difficulty of transporting a body; it is not the body's weight. These quantities answer different questions and never convert automatically into each other.

The following is a **new provisional reconciliation** of V6 physical handling with the staged Gameplay Loop inventory rules. It does not promote the historical Gameplay Loop file into the approved books. V6's optional encumbrance variant remains preserved as an alternative; do not add its penalties to this Load procedure.

| Carrier size | Physical carry limit in pounds | Push, drag or lift limit in pounds | Inventory capacity in Load | Casualty Load for a body of this size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny | Strength score × 7.5 | Strength score × 15 | Strength score ÷ 2 | 1.5 |
| Small | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Maximum of 0 and Strength score − 2 | 3 |
| Medium | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Strength score | 6 |
| Large | Strength score × 30 | Strength score × 60 | Strength score × 2 | 12 |

Use the character's current Strength score, not the modifier or an imported monster score. Tiny's Inventory capacity and casualty Load are new provisional additions. The pound limits come from V6; Small, Medium and Large Load values come from the Gameplay Loop. Larger unsupported transport sizes require their own completed rule before this table can handle them.

Keep fractional Loads without rounding. An item with a printed Load uses that value. If it has only a known weight, its **provisional Load is pounds divided by ten**. A Load-only item may use ten pounds per Load as a clearly labeled estimate for ordinary hauling; this is insufficient for effects requiring documented physical mass.

Count a container's own empty Load plus the contents' Loads, unless an explicitly inclusive Load already covers those exact contents. Handle pounds separately: sum the empty container weight and contents' weights, or use an explicitly inclusive gross weight for the contents it covers. An inclusive Load does not make a printed weight inclusive, or vice versa. Apply this rule through nested containers and meld budgets so every item counts exactly once in each quantity.

With positive carried Load at or above half capacity and no greater than capacity, you are **Burdened**: reduce Speed by 10 feet and apply disadvantage to checks to climb, swim or move silently. An empty inventory is not Burdened, including at zero capacity. Above capacity, that inventory cannot be carried routinely; drop or transfer something, or use a legal alternative such as dragging or a vehicle. These threshold and zero-Load details are provisional clarifications.

Apply actual physical limits when handling a known weight. Between physical carry capacity and twice that capacity, pushing or dragging uses the lower of otherwise-current Speed and 5 feet. A Speed of 0 stays 0; a Speed of 3 stays 3. Lifting does not independently permit movement: moving while supporting a weight must satisfy carrying, pushing, dragging or another exact rule. An anatomy restriction, such as Hawk's prohibition on carrying a Medium ally, still applies even if numbers would fit. Burden penalties do not create hands, harnesses, lift or access to melded gear.

Transporting a creature must pass both checks: the carrier can physically handle the body's effective weight and associated equipment, and can accommodate the casualty Load plus the equipment's Load. Petrified multiplies the body weight by ten, not its casualty Load. Removing gear can reduce equipment weight and Load; it cannot reduce the body's weight or erase its condition.

NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

exactAuthority.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; source Instantaneous metadata preserved. Preserve the printed effect: a genuine gateway to a plane compatible with the caster’s alignment. NEW finite completion: concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds and two fixed linked 5-foot-wide ×8-foot-high vertical apertures.

Before payment: (1) compute the caster’s current effective canonical nine-point alignment only when both axes are defined, applying underlying records/AP-AS-01 then AC4 Lock/Anchor snapshots under AC4-ALIGN-01; (2) choose a different actual destination `planeKey` and genuinely known `siteId`; (3) that plane/site record must carry Alignment-Portal compatibility for the effective alignment; (4) use AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 to choose a perceived clear supported origin pose and the site’s already-recorded destination `portalPose`. Portal formation itself moves no body/object, so Dimensional Anchor is not a formation blocker. Mortal Wheel labels/rumor do not supply a plane/site mapping.

Successful resolution snapshots the compatibility alignment key and both aperture poses. Later alignment changes do not close the gate. Apertures remain fixed. The gateway is bidirectional while active. Ordinary sight may see through only where geometry permits, but the portal grants no cross-plane spell/attack/remote-sense line of effect; its permission is physical crossing.

Transport classification for this spell only: crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. Therefore No Escape blocks a voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. Forced movement can carry a body through only under AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 and is not voluntary.

Crossing one aperture costs 5 feet base ordinary movement, modified by actual difficult terrain/crawling/squeezing. Large through the 5-foot aperture requires legal one-size-smaller squeeze and pays the real squeeze movement/penalties. Carried creatures are separate travelers; all bodies must fit/support and pass blockers. Use prospective arrival provenance from AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03 for destination Planar Protection before placement. At each crossing, revalidate the actual origin/destination body footprints, occupancy/support, current Dimensional Anchor and destination ward. A known Anchor-blocked crossing commits no movement; a live portal can remain present until its normal deadline. Known illegal crossing commits no 5-foot movement; legality changing after a legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin with no split/bisection.

Successful transit commits `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey` to the actual origin planeKey only. Transit completed before deadline completes; at deadline no new crossing begins. Suppression makes apertures unusable without pausing deadline and never ejects a traveler. No return exists after closure, but while active either aperture can be used in either direction under the same real gates. No cosmological/native/soul/deity fact is inferred.

exactAuthority.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. exactAuthority.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. exactAuthority.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
exactAuthority.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
exactAuthority.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. exactAuthority.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. exactAuthority.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
exactAuthority.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
exactAuthority.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
exactAuthority.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
exactAuthority.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

exactAuthority.activationAndGeometry: KEEP Abjuration6, Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and concentration up to60elapsed seconds. NEW choose a fixed vertical rectangular wall up to30feet wide and15feet high, with1foot thickness, resting on actual ground. Choose its full position/orientation before commitment; every point must be within60feet and caster line of effect at formation. Width and height use whole5foot panels, producing at most18panels. No curved dome, moving wall or physical material is supplied. The initial volume must be free of creature bodies and solid terrain; known conflict fails preflight, a hidden conflict discovered at resolution defeats the whole paid formation. The wall is visible but transparent to ordinary sight/sound and does not itself supply cover.
exactAuthority.eligibility: NEW PB-PRED-01, scoped only to this wall: a creature qualifies if an actual operative source explicitly classifies it as extraplanar, or an actual established native-plane relationship places its native plane elsewhere than the wall's plane. A mere current visitor is not assigned a native plane. A record that expressly changes/suppresses that classification is honored for its stated duration. Without either affirmative established basis, this wall imposes no blocking branch; that operational absence is not proof the creature is native or non-extraplanar. Elemental, Fey, Fiend, Humanoid, summoned, outsider and extraplanar are not interchangeable labels. The Director may record a genuinely NEW campaign creature classification explicitly before play, but may not claim it was recovered from cosmology or infer it from a hidden soul theory.
exactAuthority.physicalCrossing: An operative panel blocks a qualifying creature's attempted voluntary or forced physical crossing at its boundary, including that body carried, dragged, grappled or ridden by another. Every separately transported creature retains its own eligibility; hiding a qualifying passenger under a cloak does not turn it into gear. Stop the actual crossing transaction before any qualifying body intersects the panel; no part is severed, squeezed through by changing its name, or left behind without an independently legal release. Movement used to reach the boundary remains spent; impossible remaining movement is not performed. A nonqualifying carrier can release the passenger through its actual available action and move alone if then legal. Nonqualifying bodies, ordinary objects, air, sound and actual attacks pass under their own rules. Going around a real edge remains possible. The wall deals no damage, imposes no extra save and grants no free force or opportunity attack. CURRENT EXPLICIT VERTICAL-FALL EXCEPTION: apply fallingAndPlacement below when gravity carries a body down through a top/bottom edge; the wall supplies no horizontal supporting face. This exception does not authorize lateral passage through an otherwise operative broad vertical face.
exactAuthority.fallingAndPlacement: Selective wall supplies no horizontal support. Unsupported Falling continues under the ordinary Fall Marker. QUALIFICATION-CHANGE branch: if an existing body becomes qualifying while intersecting an otherwise operative fixed5x5 panel, that entire panel is pending until no qualifying body intersects it; it supplies no blocking while pending. This whole-panel rule is for a body becoming qualifying inside an operative panel, not for antimagic clipping. NEW explicit completion for the existing no-platform promise: downward Falling through a top/bottom edge is not stopped by this selective wall. If that lawful vertical entry creates actual interior body overlap with a fixed panel, mark the whole intersected panel pending until qualifying bodies clear, exactly as for qualification-change occupancy. Other operative panels still block lateral crossing. A lateral forced movement component toward an operative face stops at its boundary while the independent unsupported vertical fall keeps its original marker/distance history. No support, extra save, impact damage or new Fall Marker is supplied by the wall itself.
exactAuthority.teleportAndTerminalReturn: The wall checks an actual transport destination footprint against its operative thickness for qualifying creature bodies; a destination that intersects is barred by this scoped magical endpoint-prevention rule. A fitting destination beyond the wall does not cross a fictitious physical path and is permitted unless another actual rule prevents that transport. An origin alone touching the wall does not bar leaving. Apply each transport source's normal atomic failure/payment rule. Ordinary Banishment's accepted BAN-CLOSE-03 terminal return expressly overrides endpoint transport prevention: this wall cannot keep that ended cell open. It does not remove real terrain or other bodies. If that mandatory return legally places a qualifying body in the wall thickness, the occupied panel becomes pending under the rule above; no general voluntary-transit bypass is granted.
exactAuthority.suppressionAndEnding: The nonphysical ongoing rank6 wall has one parent and fixed5x5 panels. LOCAL-SUPPRESSION branch: a suppressor removes only the exact geometric portions it intersects while concentration/deadline continue. At resumption, each previously suppressed clear portion returns; an exact suppressed portion intersecting a qualifying body remains absent until clear. Unsuppressed portions were never removed. This clipped-portion rule is distinct from the qualification-change whole-panel pending rule. Losing actual ground support invalidates dependent panels for the remainder of this cast. One active Planar Barrier per caster. Expiry, concentration ending or eligible whole-source removal ends all panels.
exactAuthority.currentPanelPrecision: Fixed5ft panels remain the authored wall cells. For local suppression, preserve exact clipped intersection geometry; do not rectangularize a sphere. For qualification change in an otherwise operative panel, pending applies to the whole5ft panel. Neither branch crushes/ejects, tactically reselects a hole, or refreshes duration. For pending-panel occupancy use actual positive-volume interior overlap. Merely touching a neighboring panel face/edge does not occupy that panel. The one-foot wall thickness participates in spherical clipping; y=0 diagrams are cross-sections only.

operational.targets: Self; choose one exact known canonical factionId.
operational.resolution: No roll. Privately learn one actual current major institutional objective of the chosen faction. No physical representative, positive reputation, membership, Faction Seal permission, geographic distance or planar anchor is required.
operational.effect: A qualifying objective is a concrete established goal pursued or prioritized by the institution or its recognized governing authority, such as securing a trade route, recovering a stolen archive or removing a named governor from office. A member’s private wish, reputation inference or the Director’s preferred plot is not an institutional objective. If several objectives are genuinely coequal, the Director records one stable priority selection while that institutional state remains materially unchanged. Equivalent repeat casts across casters/rephrasing do not rotate through hidden coequal goals. Report No Current Major Objective only for genuine established absence; undefined or specifically protected institutional information reports Indeterminate. Independently readable portions of a meaningful goal may be stated while protected details remain Indeterminate, without identifying which ward or hidden record caused the limit.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, duration, targets, uses or information.
operational.limitations: Protection of one leader’s personal information does not erase an independently established institutional objective, and a protected private plan does not become institutional merely to evade protection. A subfaction must have its own actual canonical identity to be selected separately; invented subdivisions are not extra inquiries. The spell does not directly reveal an operational plan, member list, exact locations, timetable, secret agents, resources or every subordinate objective. A goal can naturally mention a readable subject as necessary to make it concrete, but supplies no additional dossier. It changes neither reputation nor faction intent and forces no action. Actual class access, repertoire, V/S/F components, costs, Dissonance/Refrain, beginning hooks, concentration transitions and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Commit costs before the counter window; failed, blocked and countered effects do not refund costs or restore prior concentration. Use the actual casting class's school and rank. Specific information protections apply to their actual subjects and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts are readable; undefined facts are not invented. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

completeSharedRules.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. completeSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. completeSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. completeSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. completeSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
